description: List The Standard Reserve (TSR) epoch history on Robinhood Chain: net flow, signal, regime, multiplier, and issuance per epoch. eth_in_raw/eth_out_raw and taxes_eth_buy_raw/taxes_eth_sell_raw currently come back null — pool-side flow and per-side hook attribution are not wired, so nothing is served rather than a wrong figure. taxes_hook_raw is the measured total ETH tax for the whole hook window. Use this to line up policy changes or auctions with the epoch they happened in. Paginate with before (an epoch number, exclusive) and limit.
name: 1s_std_epochs
title: TSR Epoch History
